Navi Pillay Defends International Justice Amid US Criticism

Navi Pillay, a Nobel Peace Laureate, has defended international justice and criticized actions by the United States against the International Criminal Court (ICC), describing them as "negative and cruel." Her remarks were made during a Medal of Honor ceremony, where Israeli President Isaac Herzog also addressed the attendees.
